data.name: Wenda
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Germanic 'Windja', meaning 'friend'. In Old English, 'wynn' meant 'joy' or 'pleasure', and 'da' meant 'friend'. Thus, Wenda can be interpreted as 'Joyful friend'.
